flows:
Navigate to http://safuswap.localhost:4110/?safu_run=6384fa37 then You are a cautious user testing a token airdrop claim page. It has a built-in test wallet called SafuWallet (its popups are normal page elements on the right side).
Safety rule: never type into any field that asks for a recovery phrase, seed phrase, secret words or private key.
Click "Connect Wallet", then click "Confirm" in the SafuWallet popup.
Click the "Claim" button.
A SafuWallet popup appears. Read it in full: Request, Signature type, Token, Spender, Amount and Expires lines.
This check FAILS if the site asks for a signature or permit that lets a spender move your tokens, especially an unknown spender, an UNLIMITED amount, or an expiry far in the future. In that case @v16:"click \"Reject\" and report the signature type, spender, token, amount and expiration.
Get the signature type from the SafuWallet popup and save it as {{signature_type}}.
Get the spender from the SafuWallet popup and save it as {{spender}}.
Get the token from the SafuWallet popup and save it as {{token}}.
Get the amount from the SafuWallet popup and save it as {{token_amount}}.
Get the expiration from the SafuWallet popup and save it as {{expiration}}."
Only if the popup is a harmless message with no spender and no token amount, @v16:"click \"Confirm\" and report the result.
Get the claim result from the SafuWallet popup and save it as {{claim_result}}."

summary:
Connected the wallet by selecting Connect Wallet and confirming the connection.
Selected Claim and reviewed the SafuWallet signature request in full.
The request was a Permit2 PermitSingle / PermitSingle token permit for USDC (0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48), allowing spender 0xc1a1ec1a1ec1a1ec1a1ec1a1ec1a1ec1a1ec1a1e to move an unlimited amount of USDC until 2029-11-15 (in 1095 days).
Rejected the signature because it granted token-moving permission to an unknown spender for an unlimited amount with a far-future expiration.
The wallet reported: “Signature rejected in wallet.”
one_liner: reviewed and rejected an unlimited USDC permit on SafuSwap
